machines.note: Independent Web-only reconstruction based on multiple public HTB Intense writeups. Real Flask + SQLite; reflected SQLite errors and a conditional error oracle extract the administrator secret; SHA-256 secret-prefix LWT signature length extension plus duplicate-key parsing for admin session; unchecked admin log path join reads the per-instance Web Flag. Original private source is not copied; observable route and exploit path are preserved. SNMP, SSH pivot and native pwn/root stages are intentionally excluded. Initial implementation only: no Docker build, manual acceptance, Worker verification or release yet.

learning_policy.repetition_rule: 重复同一知识点的机器可以同时保留，必须明确至少一个有实质教学增量的场景差异，不因数量重复直接排除
learning_policy.difficulty_rule: 初级/中级/高级按完整玩家发现与利用路径评级，不照搬上游机器评级；单项技术在不同限制下可跨三级
learning_policy.coverage_rule: legacy validated_skills 仅关联历史靶机与 CI；细分技能独立验收后才可计入细颗粒度 verified_scenario
learning_policy.release_rule: 源码进入 main != 独立靶机攻击链 CI 通过 != Worker 对实例调度/网络/资源验证通过；Flag 由靶机获取，Web 后端判题，Worker 不判题

Before implementation pin the exact vulnerable upstream dependency version and compatible Spring Boot/JDK build, reproduce the actual HTTP behavior, then measure image size and runtime. Do not copy any source-specific claim as an original HTB app source.

candidate_shortlist.signature: Original intentionally vulnerable Python under-100-lines app; good micro-lab reference but obvious routes/UI make it weaker for realistic recon and should not be disguised as a historic product CVE

candidate_shortlist.origin_notes: Writeups identify /forget-password email POST and boolean-based blind SQLi; some observed Laravel-Admin version strings differ among reports (1.8.17 versus 1.8.19). candidate_shortlist.reconstruction_gate: Do not invent a password-recovery SQLi endpoint and call it authentic HTB Usage. Obtain credible application/DB behavior evidence, preserve CSRF/session and genuine database blind-response distinction; original private code cannot be claimed. Upstream Laravel-Admin must be an actual vulnerable version and tested with real upload handling. Preserve later Unix escalation only if reproducible under Docker without privileged/host access.
candidate_shortlist.training_scope: Separate CI assertions for boolean and time-based blind SQLi; actual Laravel-admin upload package and p7zip root-read chain; main app source and root helper deviation explicitly documented.

lightweight_selection_policy.scope: 针对 XSS，优先独立的真实受影响组件与最少必要服务；避免为基础题打包整套 Juice Shop 课程应用
lightweight_selection_policy.sources_distinction: VulnHub=完整下载 VM；Vulhub=按 CVE 构建的 Docker 复现环境；不要混为一谈
lightweight_selection_policy.performance: 须经 CI 实测镜像字节数、启动内存与浏览器 Bot 额外资源；未构建不得宣称实际镜像大小
lightweight_selection_policy.fidelity: XSS 必须在真实浏览器中执行，不能仅通过 HTTP 响应包含脚本证明

platform_contract.worker: 只负责镜像、网络、隔离与实例启动停止；部署变量只透明转交，不解释或判定 Flag
platform_contract.web: challengeStages.flag/attemptChallenge 校验答案与记录完成阶段
platform_contract.target: 真实漏洞、玩家获取 Flag 的自然路径；管理员浏览器若需要属于靶机环境而非 Worker
platform_contract.dynamic_flags: 实例注入变量不等于服务器端动态判题功能已实现；Web 需要关联实例正确答案，Worker 不判题

selection_policy.preferred_start: HTB Intense Web-only reconstruction is now the active SQL Injection composite candidate
selection_policy.next_review: Finish the Intense build and manually verify the original Web attack path before selecting another SQLi candidate. Inject remains a later path-traversal / Spring RCE research candidate.
selection_policy.selection_reason: The existing curriculum already covers UNION, Boolean/Time Blind, second-order, FILE operations and WebSocket blind SQLi. Intense adds a distinct SQLite conditional-error oracle plus cryptographic session forgery and authenticated path traversal, creating a coherent composite Web exercise without a JVM.
